finetune.note: **Pipeline test only, not your voice yet.** On 2026-10-21 the full fine-tuning pipeline (train, then merge, then convert, then compare) ran end to end on 12 synthetic test clips: 8 training steps in 1.0 min, peak GPU memory 2.1 GB, 13.1 M trainable parameters (1.6% of the model, LoRA rank 32). The trained model loaded in VoiceType's real engine with the same speed as the base model (0.28 s vs 0.27 s per clip) and no loss of accuracy on reference English. Both scored 0% errors because the test clips were synthetic speech labelled by the base model itself, so there was nothing to improve; the verdict was correctly NOT BETTER. The real comparison needs 30-60 minutes of your own recordings (`scripts/record_voice.py`).
